tasks.title: Integrate Web Platform Toolchain into ElmerFEM Repository
tasks.description: Add frontend and backend workspaces to the existing ElmerFEM repository, establishing a unified toolchain for the web platform components.
tasks.details:
• Create `frontend/` and `backend/` directories within the existing ElmerFEM repository structure.
• Update the root `.gitignore` to exclude Node.js and Python artifacts (e.g., `node_modules/`, `__pycache__/`, `.venv/`). Add a root `.editorconfig`.
• Frontend: Initialize a Vite project in `frontend/` (`npm create vite@latest . -- --template react-ts`). Use Node 20.11. Configure a `pnpm` workspace at the repository root.
• Backend: Initialize a Poetry project in `backend/` (`poetry init`) for Python 3.11. Add dependencies: fastapi==0.110.*, uvicorn[standard]==0.27.*, pydantic==2.*, jinja2==3.*, pytest==8.*.
• Configure pre-commit hooks (black, ruff, isort, prettier, eslint, commitlint) for the new frontend and backend codebases.
• Add a dedicated GitHub Actions workflow to lint and run initial tests for the frontend and backend on push/PR.
tasks.testStrategy: Run `pnpm install && pnpm -r lint` (should exit 0); run `poetry run pytest -q` (no tests yet → passes); push branch → GitHub Action executes without failure.

tasks.title: Create Docker Compose Environment
tasks.description: Integrate the existing ElmerFEM Docker build with new frontend and backend services into a unified, single-command docker-compose setup.
tasks.details:
• docker-compose.yml services:
   1. backend: build ./backend, mount ./workspace volume, expose 8000.
   2. frontend: node:lts-alpine, command `pnpm dev`, env BACKEND_URL=http://backend:8000, expose 5173, depends_on backend.
   3. elmer: build context ./elmer_fem_docker (using the existing elmer.dockerfile), entrypoint sh (idle).
• Named volume workspace mounted into /usr/src/elmerfem/work inside elmer.
• Health-checks for backend (GET /health) and elmer (`ElmerSolver --version`).
• Makefile targets: `make up`, `make down`, `make elmer-shell`.
tasks.testStrategy: `make up` boots containers; `docker compose ps` shows healthy; exec into elmer container and run `ElmerSolver --version` (returns version string).

tasks.title: Backend Core API & Job Orchestration
tasks.description: Implement FastAPI service exposing REST endpoints for simulations and orchestrating Docker execution.
tasks.details:

  GET  /api/simulations/{id}/status → {progress,state,msg}
  GET  /api/simulations/{id}/result  → stream file/json
• Job flow (pseudo-code):
  async def launch_job(params):
      workdir = Path('/workspace')/uuid4()
      render_sif(params, workdir/'case.sif')
      cmd=["docker","compose","exec","-T","elmer","ElmerSolver","case.sif"]
      proc = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(*cmd,cwd=workdir,stdout=PIPE,stderr=STDOUT)
      persist job id → redis (or in-mem dict for MVP).
• Use Pydantic v2 models; dependency injection for settings via pydantic-settings.
• Add /health endpoint.

tasks.title: Extend Fortran Code for Simplified Materials
tasks.description: Modify ModelDescription.F90 & Types.F90 so ElmerSolver understands new `MaterialLibrary` keyword generated by UI.
tasks.details:
• In Types.F90: extend `Material_t` to include `hasSimplifiedId` logical & `libId` integer.
• In ModelDescription.F90 (ReadMaterial):
   IF (Keyword == 'MaterialLibrary') THEN
       CALL LoadSimplifiedMaterial(libId,Mat)
   END IF
• Implement `LoadSimplifiedMaterial` in new Fortran module MaterialLib.F90 reading /usr/src/elmerfem/work/materials.json (use Fortran 2008 intrinsic ISO_FORTRAN_ENV + simple JSON parser e.g. FSON).
• Re-compile inside Dockerfile (add `git clone https://github.com/juntsang/FSON` && make install).

<info added on 2025-07-23T21:31:02.355Z>
**UPDATE based on research:** The initial plan to modify `Types.F90` is incorrect and should be avoided. The existing flexible `ValueList_t` structure is sufficient and safer. The implementation should proceed as follows:
• **No changes to `Types.F90`**. The `hasSimplifiedId` and `libId` fields are not needed in the core data structure.
• In `ModelDescription.F90`'s `ReadMaterial`, the call should be to `LoadSimplifiedMaterial(LibId, Mat % Values)`.
• The new `LoadSimplifiedMaterial` subroutine in `MaterialLib.F90` must map the JSON keys from `materials.json` to the standard Elmer SIF keywords using `ListAddReal`:
   - `E` -> `'Youngs Modulus'`
   - `nu` -> `'Poissons Ratio'`
   - `rho` -> `'Density'`
   - `k` -> `'Heat Conductivity'`
</info added on 2025-07-23T21:31:02.355Z>

tasks.title: Instrument ElmerSolver.F90 for Progress Output
tasks.description: Emit deterministic progress lines parsable by backend without affecting solver accuracy.
tasks.details:
• In ElmerSolver.F90 main iteration loops add:
   WRITE(*,*) 'PROGRESS:',REAL(currentIter)/REAL(totalIter)*100.0
• Guard with IF (ProgressOutput) logical set via new solver flag (enable by default in educational image).
• Use format `PROGRESS: <percent> <timeStep>/<total>`.
• Update Dockerfile to rebuild.

<info added on 2025-07-23T21:32:39.730Z>
• **Research Finding:** The primary target for instrumentation is the main **Sweep Loop** in `ElmerSolver.F90`.
• This `DO WHILE (.TRUE.)` loop uses `iSweep` as the current iteration counter and `OptimIters` as the total number of iterations.
• The relevant code block is:
  ```fortran
  DO WHILE (.TRUE.)
    iSweep = iSweep + 1
    ...
    CALL ExecSimulation(...)
    ...
    IF (iSweep == OptimIters) EXIT
  END DO
  ```
• The more granular time-stepping and nonlinear iteration loops are encapsulated within the `ExecSimulation` subroutine. Instrumenting these for the `<timeStep>/<total>` part of the progress format will require deeper analysis of that subroutine.
</info added on 2025-07-23T21:32:39.730Z>
